name: teamLab Planets TOKYO
intro: A walk-through digital art museum where you go barefoot through water and rooms filled with light. Tickets are for a set date and entry time, and weekends and holidays sell out first.

facts.location: Toyosu, Tokyo (about 15 minutes by taxi from Tokyo Station)
facts.bookAhead: No fixed rule: start checking about two months ahead

statusNote: teamLab publishes no fixed release rule. Dates appear on the ticket calendar in batches.
howToBuy: Buy on the official ticket site, or at Lawson Ticket and Seven-Eleven Ticket.
Pick a date and an entry time. Weekends and holidays sell out first.

faq.q: How far in advance should I book teamLab Planets?
faq.a: There is no fixed release day. Start checking the ticket calendar about two months before your visit.

sources.quote: teamLab Planets and teamLab Borderless: start checking two months out
